title: Medical Hardship Liability Cap — Kept Share by Medical-Debt Burden
content:
## Kept share

Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), the kept share of a Medical Hardship award's hardship liability cap follows the medical-debt burden and the patient's recent payments. The annual household income recorded on the case is scaled at the cap percent and the kept share is applied to that scaled figure, the product being rounded half-up to the cent: the scaled figure is not rounded on its own, and the rounding falls once, on the product.

- **Medical-debt burden**: the qualifying medical debt recorded on the case as a percent of the annual household income recorded on the case (a household with no recorded income carries no burden).
- **Payments**: the patient payments posted on the patient's Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) accounts in the 12 whole months before the approval day; a payment belongs to those months when fewer than twelve whole months separate its posting date from the approval day, a whole month running from a day of one month to the same day of the next month or, when the next month has no such day, to the first day of the month after it.

| Burden | Payments of the 12 months | Kept share of the scaled figure |
|---|---|---|
| above 35 percent | above 10 percent of the annual household income | 0.75 |
| above 35 percent | at most 10 percent of the annual household income | 0.85 |
| above 25 and at most 35 percent | any | 0.85 |
| at most 25 percent | any | the whole figure |

## Worked case (hypothetical)

Income 50,000.00; qualifying medical debt 20,000.00 (burden 40 percent); payments 6,000.00 (12 percent of income); scaled figure at 10 percent: 5,000.00. Kept: 0.75 of 5,000.00, that is 3,750.00. With payments of 5,000.00 (exactly 10 percent), 0.85 is kept: 4,250.00.

Rounding once, on the product (hypothetical): income 60,000.30 scaled at 8.5 percent is 5,100.0255; 0.85 of 5,100.0255 is 4,335.021675, rounded half-up to 4,335.02.
